query:
INSERT INTO contract_templates (name, serviceType, contractText, isDefault, isActive) VALUES (
  'Tanzite Stone Deck — Material Purchase Agreement',
  'tanzite',
  'MATERIAL PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Material Purchase Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of the date signed below between Design Your Price LLC ("Seller") and the customer identified below ("Buyer").

PROJECT DETAILS
Product: {collectionName}
Color: {colorName}
Estimated Area: {sqft} sq ft
Labor: {laborName}
Delivery: {deliveryName}
Total Estimate: {grandTotal}

PAYMENT TERMS
A deposit of {depositAmount} is due upon signing this Agreement to confirm your order and reserve your materials.

IMPORTANT: No work, material sourcing, or project scheduling will begin until the full deposit of {depositAmount} has been received and cleared.

The remaining balance of {balanceAmount} is due upon delivery of materials to your project site. Materials will not be released for delivery until the balance is paid in full.

SCOPE OF WORK
{scopeOfWork}

ESTIMATE DISCLAIMER
This estimate is based on the dimensions and options provided through the online calculator. Final pricing may vary based on on-site measurements, site conditions, and any changes to the original scope of work. Any changes to the scope of work will be documented in a written change order signed by both parties prior to work commencing.

MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS
All Tanzite stone products are natural stone and may exhibit natural variation in color, texture, and pattern. Such variation is a characteristic of natural stone and is not considered a defect. Design Your Price does not guarantee an exact color match between samples, digital representations, and delivered materials.

INSTALLATION NOTICE
This agreement covers materials only unless a labor option has been selected above. If installation labor is included, a separate installation agreement will be provided. Buyer is responsible for ensuring the project site is accessible, level, and prepared per Design Your Price specifications prior to material delivery or installation.

DELIVERY
Delivery timelines will be communicated after order confirmation and deposit receipt. Design Your Price is not responsible for delays caused by supply chain disruptions, weather, carrier delays, or other factors outside our control. Buyer must be available to receive delivery or designate an authorized representative. Undeliverable orders due to Buyer unavailability may incur re-delivery fees.

CANCELLATION POLICY
Orders cancelled within 48 hours of signing will receive a full refund of the deposit. Cancellations after 48 hours but before materials are ordered are subject to a 20% restocking fee. Once materials have been ordered or cut, the deposit is non-refundable.

WARRANTY
Design Your Price warrants that materials delivered will conform to the product specifications described in this Agreement. This warranty does not cover damage caused by improper installation, misuse, normal wear and tear, freeze-thaw cycles, or failure to follow care and maintenance guidelines. Buyer assumes all responsibility for installation quality unless installation labor is provided by Design Your Price.

LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
In no event shall Design Your Price be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of or related to this Agreement. The total liability of Design Your Price under this Agreement shall not exceed the total amount paid by Buyer under this Agreement.

GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Utah. Any disputes arising under this Agreement shall be resolved in the courts of Utah County, Utah.

ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, warranties, and understandings of the parties.

By signing below, Buyer acknowledges that they have read, understood, and agree to all terms and conditions of this Agreement.',
  1,
  1
);
